import re

# The pdf read output has page markers like "--- Page 1 ---"
# Extract only page 1 content
lines = pdf_text.strip().split('\n')

# Find page boundaries
page1_lines = []
in_page1 = False
for line in lines:
    if '--- Page 1 ---' in line or 'Page 1' in line:
        in_page1 = True
        continue
    if in_page1 and ('--- Page 2 ---' in line or 'Page 2' in line):
        break
    if in_page1:
        page1_lines.append(line)

# If no page markers found, use all text (single page PDF)
if not page1_lines:
    first_page_text = pdf_text.strip()
else:
    first_page_text = '\n'.join(page1_lines).strip()

print(f"First page text length: {len(first_page_text)}")
print(f"Preview: {repr(first_page_text[:300])}")

# Escape the text for shell: replace single quotes
escaped_text = first_page_text.replace("'", "'\\''")
set_cell_cmd = f"python3 skills/OfficeBench/tools/excel/set_cell.py --file_path /workspace/testbed/data/extracted_text.xlsx --row_idx 2 --column_idx 1 --text '{escaped_text}'"
